name: 22-cron-run-status-counts
sql: select jobid, jobname, status, count(*) as runs, min(start_time) as first_start, max(start_time) as last_start, round(avg(extract(epoch from (end_time - start_time)))::numeric, 1) as avg_duration_s from cron.job_run_details where start_time > now() - interval '14 days' group by jobid, jobname, status order by jobid, status
